Application Data.NAME: Smithson Shipping Solutions
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smithson Shipping Solutions operates a well-organized shipping and mailing center providing services such as parcel handling, mail delivery, package tracking, and mailbox rentals. We comply with USPS regulations and have implemented robust security measures including surveillance systems and employee background checks. Our processes prioritize customer service through up-to-date technology platforms that enhance package tracking and notifications, minimizing errors and improving the overall customer experience. Additionally, we offer ancillary services like notary public and document copying, which are secondary to our primary shipping operations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a package was damaged during transit due to equipment malfunction, resulting in a total loss of $1,200. The claim was promptly filed and is currently under review with the carrier. Additionally, on August 10, 2022, there was a theft incident involving a small quantity of office supplies valued at $300. This claim was settled, and security protocols were enhanced as a result. All losses have been addressed, and preventative measures are now in place.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Hollon Security Vault, Class B, Underwriters Laboratories (UL) Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: CCTV surveillance system with 24/7 monitoring, security fencing around the premises, and background checks for all employees.
